LanguageData.SSC_Surgery_StartUterusDevelopment.label: Uterine development surgery
LanguageData.SSC_Surgery_StartUterusDevelopment.descr: Blend concentrated purple aphrodisiac nanofluid with medicine and surgically deliver the preparation into the deepest part of the womb, allowing purple nanomachines to settle in its warmth. Once the incision heals, future intercourse and pleasure will nourish the nanomachines as they continue reshaping this body's womb.
